carousel.subject: Biology

questions.q: Vitamin C ki kami se kaunsa rog hota hai?
questions.why: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) ki kami se Scurvy hota hai.

questions.q: Raat ko dikhai na dena kis vitamin ki kami se hota hai?
questions.why: Vitamin A ki kami se Night Blindness hoti hai.

questions.q: Beriberi rog kis vitamin ki kami se hota hai?
questions.why: Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) ki kami se Beriberi hota hai.

questions.q: Haddiyan kamzor karne wala Rickets kis vitamin ki kami se hota hai?
questions.why: Vitamin D ki kami se Rickets (bachon mein) hota hai.

questions.q: Khoon jamne (clotting) ke liye kaunsa vitamin zaroori hai?
questions.why: Vitamin K blood clotting mein madad karta hai.
